data.name: Lanvansh
data.gender_notes: Lanvansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lanvansh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Lan' meaning 'Lord Hanuman' and 'Vansh' meaning 'lineage' or 'blessings'. This name is a tribute to the monkey god Hanuman, who is known for his strength, courage, and loyalty. The name signifies that the child will be blessed by Lord Hanuman and will embody his qualities. The name Lanvansh carries the meaning “Lord Hanuman's blessings” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Lanvansh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord hanuman's blessings and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the strength and courage of Lord Hanuman
data.etymology: Lanvansh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Hanuman's blessings.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Lanvansh total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
